chairperson.name: Er. Ram Bahadur Shrestha
chairperson.title: Chairperson, Smart Prefab Panel
chairperson.message: Since our founding, Smart Prefab Panel has been driven by a single purpose: to give Nepali families and businesses access to building technology that is safe, fast and affordable. The 2015 earthquake reminded all of us how important it is to build responsibly. Every panel that leaves our factory carries that responsibility with it. Thank you for trusting us to help build a stronger Nepal.

about.mission: To provide earthquake-resistant, energy-efficient and cost-effective prefabricated building solutions to every corner of Nepal, using globally proven EPS and PUF panel technology.
about.vision: To become Nepal's most trusted name in prefabricated construction, recognized for quality, innovation and service across South Asia.

servicesList.name: Earthquake Resistant Structure
servicesList.summary: Panel and frame systems engineered and tested to withstand seismic activity common in Nepal.
servicesList.content: Our earthquake resistant structures combine a galvanized steel frame with EPS/PUF sandwich panels that are screwed directly into the frame, distributing seismic load evenly across the structure. This system has been used in schools, homes and commercial buildings rebuilt after the 2015 earthquake, and is designed to national building code standards for seismic zones.

servicesList.name: EPS Sandwich Panel in Nepal
servicesList.summary: Expandable Polystyrene core panels for walls and roofs with excellent insulation and light weight.
servicesList.content: EPS Sandwich Panels consist of a lightweight expanded polystyrene core bonded between two layers of galvanized steel or cement board. They are used extensively for partition walls, cold storage, poultry farms and residential construction, offering a density of just 124 kg/m3 while retaining strong thermal and sound insulation.

servicesList.name: Korean Design House in Nepal
servicesList.summary: Modular homes based on proven Korean prefabricated housing design and technology.
servicesList.content: In partnership with Korean design technology, we bring modular home designs that can be manufactured off-site and assembled in Nepal within weeks. These homes are known for clean lines, efficient space usage, high insulation performance and resistance to extreme weather.

servicesList.name: Prefab House in Nepal
servicesList.summary: Fully prefabricated houses assembled on site in a fraction of the time of conventional construction.
servicesList.content: Our prefab houses are manufactured in our factory and transported as ready panels and steel frames, then assembled on site — cutting construction time by more than half compared to brick-and-mortar construction, while maintaining strength, insulation and earthquake resistance.

servicesList.name: Sandwich PUF Panel in Nepal
servicesList.summary: Polyurethane foam core panels offering superior insulation for cold storage and industrial use.
servicesList.content: PUF (Polyurethane Foam) Sandwich Panels provide a higher insulation value than EPS, making them ideal for cold storage rooms, food processing units and industrial facilities that require strict temperature control.

servicesList.name: Wall & Roof Solutions
servicesList.summary: Complete wall and roofing systems for residential, commercial and industrial buildings.
servicesList.content: We supply and install complete wall and roof panel systems, including insulated roofing sheets, wall cladding and structural accessories, tailored to residential, commercial and industrial projects across Nepal.

faqs.question: What is the price of prefab sandwich panels per sq. ft. in Nepal?
faqs.answer: Prefab sandwich panel prices in Nepal typically range from NPR 220 to NPR 450 per sq. ft. depending on panel thickness (50mm, 75mm, 100mm) and core material (EPS or PUF). Contact our sales team for an exact factory quote.

faqs.question: Are Smart Prefab Panels earthquake resistant?
faqs.answer: Yes! Our structural panel system is screwed directly into high-tensile galvanized light gauge steel frames, evenly distributing seismic load across the entire structure to comply with Nepal National Building Code.

faqs.question: What is the lifespan of a prefab house in Nepal?
faqs.answer: Built with anti-corrosive zinc-coated steel skins and UV-resistant insulating cores, Smart Prefab Panel buildings have an engineered lifespan exceeding 50+ years with minimal maintenance.

faqs.question: How fast can a prefab house be completed in Nepal?
faqs.answer: A typical 2-story residential prefab home can be manufactured in 5–7 days and assembled on site within 10–15 days, saving over 60% construction time compared to brick and mortar.

faqs.question: What is the difference between EPS and PUF sandwich panels?
faqs.answer: EPS (Expanded Polystyrene) panels are lightweight, cost-effective, and ideal for residential homes and partition walls. PUF (Polyurethane Foam) panels offer higher R-value thermal density, making them optimal for cold storage and extreme temperature control.

faqs.question: Can Smart Prefab Panel buildings be used in hilly and mountain regions of Nepal?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Our lightweight prefab system is ideal for remote hill districts where transporting heavy materials is difficult. Panels can be transported by smaller vehicles and assembled without heavy machinery.

faqs.question: Do you provide installation services across all 77 districts?
faqs.answer: Yes. We have an authorised dealer and installation network across all 77 districts of Nepal, ensuring professional assembly and after-sales support regardless of your project location.

faqs.question: What thickness of EPS panel should I choose for my home?
faqs.answer: For standard residential walls in Nepal's climate, 75mm EPS is most popular, offering a good balance of insulation and strength. 50mm is used for interior partitions and 100mm for cold storage or extreme weather applications.

faqs.question: Is a dealership available in my district?
faqs.answer: We are rapidly expanding our dealer network. Visit our Dealership page to apply or contact our sales team to check availability in your area. We provide training, marketing support and factory direct pricing to all authorised dealers.

faqs.question: Do Smart Prefab Panel products meet Nepal National Building Code?
faqs.answer: Yes. All our structural systems are designed by licensed civil and structural engineers to comply with the Nepal National Building Code (NBC), including seismic zone requirements for the Kathmandu Valley and other earthquake-prone areas.
